verdict.rationale: Jan ships a built-in OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337 (optionally exposed on the LAN) that serves as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs, so chat and inference are reachable programmatically. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covering the rest of the UI: model hub downloads and imports, assistant and project management, MCP configuration and tool approvals, or settings are all documented only as UI actions, and no published OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: API endpoints for model download/import/management, assistant and project CRUD, MCP and tool-approval control, settings management, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
